Lincoln City host Wolves at LNER stadium in round 18 of the Championship. The odds bookmakers offered on this match give Wolves a 60% win probability, compared with 17% for Lincoln City.

Current Form - Lincoln City

Lincoln City are 21st with 15 points from 17 matches, having recorded four wins, three draws and 10 losses, with a 15-31 goal record. Their last league match ended in a 0-4 loss away to Charlton, and their recent five-match record is five losses. Over those five matches, they scored 0.4 goals per game against 0.9 across the season, while conceding 2.2 per game compared with 1.8 overall. Their expected goals average is 1.23, below the league average of 1.47, while their expected goals conceded average is 1.64.

Current Form - Wolves

Wolves are third on 34 points from 17 matches, with 10 wins, four draws and three losses and a 31-19 goal record. Their last league match was a 3-0 home win over Derby. The Old Gold have gone eight overall matches without defeat, while their last five produced four wins and one draw. In that recent sequence, they scored 2.2 goals per game against 1.8 for the season and conceded 0.6 compared with 1.1 overall. Their expected goals average is 1.94, above the league average of 1.47.

Head-to-Head Record

This will be the first-ever meeting between these two teams.

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

Freddie Draper has scored two goals and supplied one assist in 15 games for Lincoln City. Andrei Coubis, a defender, has one goal and two assists in 13 games, while midfielder Dom Jefferies has scored two goals in 14 games. Tendayi Darikwa is unavailable for the match with a knee injury.

Wolves’ leading scorer Adam Armstrong has seven goals in 15 games, including five in his last five matches; he scored in four of those games and twice in the latest. Fernando Lopez has six goals and three assists in 16 games, while Mateus Mane has one goal and three assists.
